title: Package custom rename filter defaults
summary: Ensure deployment/package validation preserves the current packaged custom movie rename filters instead of comparing package config to generic backend defaults.
reason: The operator wants the current custom rename filter list to be the shipped default list in deployments, not a repository-generic default baseline.
behavior_before: Release checks described and validated packaged rename filters as the standard backend default baseline, so a custom packaged list could be mistaken for drift from generic defaults.
behavior_after: The shipped config template and default profile carry the operator's current live rename filter list, and release checks treat that packaged template as the custom deployment baseline that the default profile must match.
manual_validation: Compared the three rename-filter keys from %LOCALAPPDATA%/MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO/MediaPipeline_config.psd1 against ops/pipeline/config/MediaPipeline_config_template.psd1 and ops/pipeline/config/profiles/Default.psd1 - both deployment files matched the live custom filter options, term lists, and removal terms
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 - passed after the deployment files were updated to the live custom list

ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -BundleRoot . -SkipToolIntegration -SkipEndToEndSmoke - Custom Rename Filters section passed for both deployment files; full command still failed later on unrelated existing desktop Python unit, summary/project-index freshness, and zeroconf worker-environment issues

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths ops/pipeline/config/MediaPipeline_config_template.psd1 ops/pipeline/config/profiles/Default.psd1 ops/scripts/release/build.ps1 ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 ops/release/changes/unreleased/MP-CHANGE-2026-0615-007.json - passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - passed with 310 valid unreleased change packet(s)
rollback_plan: Revert the release/package guard text and comparison changes plus this change packet. Existing rename filter config values would remain in the package files but release checks would again compare against backend defaults.
notes:
Opened before edits. Scope is release package/config validation wording and packaged rename-filter defaults only; no source media, scratch/output movement, FFmpeg, subtitle, audio, publish/drain, queue launch, settings-save, or cleanup behavior is changed.
Release/package checks now use the packaged config template/profile as the custom rename filter deployment baseline instead of comparing those files to backend default functions.
Deployment template/profile rename filters were copied from the live app config keys only: RenameMovieFilterOptions, RenameMovieFilterTerms, and RenameMovieRemoveTerms.
